user_requested: Retain only best.pth selected by validation macro-F1; exact ties keep earlier epoch.
Review and optimize avoidable code overhead without changing the training method.
Add improved image-mean-colour padding that preserves aspect ratio.
Use the normalization, interpolation and input resolution matching the pretrained Swin-Small checkpoint.

fetch.reason: Defer requests/gdown imports until the download branch; local/cache input logic is unchanged.

attach_images.reason: Record original width/height during the existing image-read validation; no rows or labels changed.

FrameDataset.reason: Shared aspect-preserving bicubic resize/padding; mean-fill rotation/translation; cached paths/labels. Original augmentation probabilities/ranges and normalization retained.

make_loaders.reason: Pass preprocessing configuration to datasets. Original inverse-class-frequency replacement sampler, epoch length, batch/workers/drop_last and pin_memory retained.

epoch_pass.reason: Only add non_blocking=True to image/label device transfers. Numeric loss, AMP, backward/optimizer steps, predictions and ordering retained.

train_run.reason: Preserve best-only validation macro-F1 policy and original loss-based early stopping; record preprocessing and torchvision in protocol, validate pretrained contract, pass preprocessing to loaders.

preprocessing.old_resize: Direct bilinear resize to 224x224, with black-fill geometry augmentation.
preprocessing.new_resize: Full-frame aspect-preserving bicubic resize followed by centered edge-to-image-mean blended padding.
preprocessing.normalization: Unchanged ImageNet mean/std; fixed pretrained checkpoint contract.
preprocessing.geometric_augmentation: Same flip probabilities, rotation/translation ranges and nearest interpolation; mean RGB replaces black fill.
preprocessing.padding_alternative: padding.method: mean for constant image-mean padding in a separate run.

resnet_reference.difference: Compute final-size padding after proportional resize, blend only padding, retain transformer augmentation ranges.

unchanged: Original metadata, labels, counts, validation guards and grouped split procedure/seed.
Original TransformerClassifier body, fine-tuning defaults, L2 feature normalization, heads and architecture.
Original weighted sampling distribution and number of draws; no pre-generated augmented copies.
Unweighted CE/BCE losses, AMP, optimizer, LR schedule, batch size and loss-based early stopping.
registry: The explicit ms_in22k_ft_in1k tag is the original untagged model default in timm 1.0.22; verified from wheel and live registry.
exports: Shared deterministic geometry, hash-verified originals, atomic refreshed test PNGs, per-frame geometry audit and training-only previews.
resume: Fresh default *_padded_v3 run names; preprocessing/config/code/runtime guards prevent mixing old weights or incompatible reports. Full state is stored only at the selected best epoch.
performance: No GPU speedup or clinical accuracy claim; GPU training was not executed.
